resolution.note: fast-check resolves tools from the main checkout or exits 64 naming the fix

title: npm run fast: explain missing node_modules in fresh worktrees
body: Finding 2026-11-07 (lead): in a fresh worktree without node_modules, `npm run fast` prints "fast FAIL (tsc)" after 24 ms with no reason; agents then misread it as a type error. Make fast-check detect missing node_modules and either say so (exit 64, "run npm ci or link node_modules") or resolve tools from the main checkout; consider linking node_modules automatically when the lead creates a worktree.
